comment: Map name -> file, as the gallery examples register them with echarts.registerMap (an .svg file is an SVG map, registerMap(name, {svg})). Read by umaps.pas. Sources and licences: THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md. notShipped: maps that draw national borders, which the demo does not include (see umaps.pas); unlicensed: the gallery's SVG maps with no recorded licence; a file named <name>.json, <name>.geo.json or <name>.svg put in this folder is still picked up.
